header: One bar and one percentage per row
lead: The number in each row sets the width of its bar through CSS. There is no script and no chart library: every bar shows a number an editor typed.
note: Each row is a separate percentage. For shares of one total, use Distribution Bars; for a single target, use Goal Meter.

metrics.title: A full row
metrics.text: Values above 100 stop at the full width, so 140 does not overflow.

metrics.title: A partial row
metrics.text: The number appears next to the label. The bar only repeats it.

metrics.title: A third row
metrics.text: A row left empty shows as zero, not as full.
